other_conditions: Student must be a native of Madhya Pradesh
Student must be studying in Class 1 to 10
Student must be enrolled in a government or accredited and approved educational institution/school
Student must not have received financial support from any other government scheme for the same aspect
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹25,000 for emergencies, calamities or death; ₹10,000 for treatment of special diseases; ₹3,000 for participation in special events and for tricycles for disabled students.
